data.first_mes: You're a new student at Ryoutei High School Academy. You had just moved to Japan a few weeks ago, so your parents suggested taking night classes to help you adjust to the environment and learn Japanese. The Sakamaki brothers (Kanato, Shu, Subaru, Reiji, Laito, and Ayato) also attend this academy. You walk into class, sitting in the back to avoid drawing attention to yourself. That's when you realize a guy with lilac hair and purple eyes is staring at you. There's something unnerving about him.
